races.name: Guinness Irish EBF Nursery Handicap

runners_data.name: I Ready
runners_data.note: Front-runner wearing headgear (hg:p) who has strong course form on Good ground (4/4 sim-going, 1 win), steps up to 7f for the first time which is the key question, but the uncontested lead is a significant compensating advantage; STYLE_FIT tag is a minor concern as she lands her natural role here.
runners_data.comment: Fresh off a win 11 days ago, I Ready has experience of today's distance and going and arrives in form carrying 140 lb from stall 7; the main risk is that his three starts before that victory brought an eighth, fifth and sixth.

runners_data.name: Banks Of The Boyne
runners_data.note: Unknown style runner who holds a placed effort at 8f suggesting stamina, but the fading-in-finish flag is worrying at 7f on Good ground, and Wesley Joyce's 3/15 14-day strike rate does not inspire; likely to do best work too late.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last three starts — second last time out but unplaced and eighth in the two prior runs — Banks Of The Boyne carries 139 lb from stall eight, and our rating of 68 leaves him well held against this field on current form.

runners_data.name: Bold Commander
runners_data.note: A P O'Brien second-string type with an unknown style tag who has placed twice at 5f, stepping up to 7f for the first time here — Jack Cleary riding and the extra furlong could unlock more, making this a classic trip-up angle to monitor.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last three starts, Bold Commander does bring going and distance experience to the table, and that second two starts back shows he can mix it at this level; the fifth last time out, however, suggests he's one to approach with caution from stall 4 off 139 lb.

runners_data.name: Seven Nation Army
runners_data.note: Joseph Patrick O'Brien's hold-up runner whose last three form figures read 8-8-6 in similar company on Good, with the one bright spot a runner-up at 6f; needs others to set a more pressured tempo than I Ready is likely to provide.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts, Seven Nation Army showed signs of life with a runner-up finish last time out, 11 days ago — fitness isn't an issue. He has experience of today's trip and going, and a trainer firing at 28%, though stall one and 137 lb are notable factors.

runners_data.name: Margot Mae
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has form specifically over this 7f trip on Good (placed at 7f/Soft), travels handy for Scott McCullagh and looks well positioned to exploit the uncontested pace if she can reproduce that staying effort; the step back to Good from Soft is no concern.
runners_data.comment: Margot Mae showed her best when third two starts back, and having run over today's trip and going, she arrives here fresh on 21 days' rest carrying 136 lb from stall three; winless in her last three, but her rating of 90 marks her as the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Celtic Moon
runners_data.note: J P Murtagh's lightly raced filly arrives on the back of a maiden win over 8f on Good with Ben Coen retaining the ride; dropping back from a mile to 7f looks the only question, but her prominent style fits this shape cleanly and she is the one with a winning profile.
runners_data.comment: Celtic Moon arrives on the back of a win last time out, has experience of today's trip and conditions, and her rating of 85 suggests she's well treated; the sole concern is a trainer who has drawn a blank in 23 attempts over the past fortnight.

runners_data.name: Eighteenth Smiles
runners_data.note: O'Brien hold-up filly who has finished in the top five in three consecutive runs without threatening, and the pattern of 5-5-5 at 6f on Good suggests she is competitive but not a winner in this mode; needs a pace collapse that is unlikely here.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts, Eighteenth Smiles nevertheless brings strong fitness from 19 days ago, has run over today's trip and going, and a trainer firing at 28% makes him a live threat — though another unplaced effort last time is the chief concern.

runners_data.name: Winnie's Wish
runners_data.note: Cromwell's hold-up filly with the lowest OR in the field (58) carries the fades-in-finish flag and is a true rear-runner repositioned forward on the pace map due to the surplus of hold-up types; Chris Hayes will likely find her back in her natural position regardless, which is the hardest berth in this race shape.
runners_data.comment: Winnie's Wish has been well beaten in each of his last three starts, including two eighths, and ranked bottom on our figures here, he is hard to fancy at the weights; the trainer's recent strike rate offers little encouragement either, though he has run over today's trip and going before.

races.paceDynamic: I Ready is the confirmed pace-setter here and, with no genuine rival to press them from the gate, should slot comfortably into a controlled lead at a sustainable gallop over Galway's flat 7f. Margot Mae and Celtic Moon are the next most prominent types and will likely track just off the leader, meaning the race develops as a well-ordered, single-file affair rather than a contested scramble. The absence of front-running pressure creates a clean, even tempo that is unlikely to leave the principals gasping turning for home, which historically at Galway benefits horses who can race prominently and quicken from a handy position in the final two furlongs. This race shape firmly favours prominent racers who can exploit the uncontested tempo — hold-up horses, including Winnie's Wish who is a true rear-runner shuffled forward on the map due to overcrowding at the rear, face the hardest task if the pace is never brisk enough to bring them into contention late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Lead, Prominent Strike
scenarios.trigger: If I Ready bowls along at a measured gallop and the prominent types track smoothly without drama.
scenarios.body: I Ready sets a sustainable pace that sets the table for Margot Mae and Celtic Moon to pounce from close range entering the final furlong, with no real end-to-end pressure to blunt their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Quickens, Front Runner Holds
scenarios.trigger: If I Ready finds an extra gear turning for home and the gap is too large to claw back.
scenarios.body: A slightly quicker early tempo than expected catches the field flat-footed and I Ready sustains the advantage all the way to the line, punishing rivals who were waiting for a move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Shuffle, Hold-Up Arrives
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop is genuinely strong and creates enough of a pace collapse entering the straight.
scenarios.body: Seven Nation Army or Eighteenth Smiles benefit from a genuine pace collapse and weave through a tiring front rank, though this shape requires conditions that appear unlikely given the single front-runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos, Outsider Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the field fans wide at Galway, traffic problems hit the fancied runners and a lightly-raced type takes advantage.
scenarios.body: Bold Commander or Banks Of The Boyne capitalise on positional errors from rivals, staying wide and finding clear daylight while the market leaders are checked or shuffled back.

watchPoints.text: Celtic Moon has not raced for 28 days, steps back in trip from a winning 8f debut on Good, and if the extra freshness translates to a forward move under Ben Coen she lands right in the pocket behind I Ready — the most dangerous prominent challenger in the race.

I Ready's headgear and front-running profile are assets, but she has never raced beyond 6f and any sign of faltering at the 2f pole would quickly bring Margot Mae and Celtic Moon past her — watch early how she settles.

Bold Commander is unproven at 7f and for a trainer with a 5/48 14-day strike rate may just be learning his trade, but A P O'Brien unknowns at Galway have a habit of outrunning their price when the trip suits.

Winnie's Wish (OR 58) is 24lb below the top weight and despite Chris Hayes's quality is a true hold-up horse in a race with a single moderate pace-maker — an odds-on scenario for struggling to reach competitive positions in time.

Banks Of The Boyne's fading-in-finish flag combined with a 22-day absence and the step up to 7f makes her a significant place risk for those who expect her to reproduce her 2nd at 6f — monitor in-running behaviour in the first half of the race.

runners_data.name: Celtic Motif
runners_data.note: The lone confirmed front-runner who can dictate her own tempo; won over 8f on Good 16 days ago and has tongue-tie fitted, giving her the tactical freedom to control this race from the front.
runners_data.comment: Celtic Motif won last time out and was second three starts back, showing consistent placed form in recent starts; she has run over today's trip and going, and a trainer firing at 28% adds stable confidence, though carrying 133 lb from stall 6 may test her.

runners_data.name: Goldilocks Cen
runners_data.note: Style is unclassified (U), making pace-mapping difficult; recent form (421-05) shows inconsistency and she has shown no win or place on Good going from four attempts, which is a concern in this surface context.
runners_data.comment: Beaten in her last two outings and ranked eighth of ten on our figures, Goldilocks Cen is hard to fancy despite carrying a manageable weight from stall five; a win three starts back hints at ability, and she has run over today's trip and going before.

runners_data.name: Greydreambeliever
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up performer who thrives at 7f on Good going — six of her last 10 runs have been at this trip and surface — and her 33-day break from an O'Brien yard in fine form makes her an ideal profile for the dominant race shape here.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and ranked ninth of ten on our figures, Greydreambeliever is hard to fancy despite the second two starts back — though she has experience over today's trip and going, and a trainer firing at 28% is worth noting.

runners_data.name: La Brodeuse
runners_data.note: Prominent-style filly who ran second on Good ground over 7f most recently; Kevin Ryan's 0/21 14-day strike rate is a noteworthy negative, and the 54-day absence adds a small fitness question.
runners_data.comment: La Brodeuse ran second two starts back and has experience of today's trip and conditions, with a rating of 104 suggesting she retains ability — but a trainer who is yet to land one in 21 attempts over the past fortnight is a concern, and she arrives 54 days fresh.

runners_data.name: Nancy J
runners_data.note: Ben Coen takes over for the in-form Murtagh yard; a true hold-up runner who has placed on Good going three times in recent starts, and her profile fits the dominant race shape cleanly if she gets a clear run in the final 2f.
runners_data.comment: Placed third last time out and third again four starts back, Nancy J shows consistency without ever threatening the top spot in recent starts — she's yet to win in her last five. Experience over today's trip and going helps, but a trainer in a cold spell and 133 lb from stall one are factors to weigh.

runners_data.name: Noli Timere
runners_data.note: Carries a headgear (p) angle and is a natural front-runner by inclination — but the surplus of prominent types means she is very unlikely to get anywhere near her preferred pitch, forcing her wide or back and materially undermining her chance.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and ranked bottom of ten on our figures, Noli Timere faces a stiff task, though she has run over today's trip and going before and returns after 50 days fresher than when last seen finishing fifth.

runners_data.name: Black Caviar Gold
runners_data.note: Has headgear (tp) fitted and has been placed at this course configuration before; the 3-year-old carries 2lbs less than older rivals and her Good-ground form (2nd, 4th at 8f) suggests she handles conditions, though her style of racing prominent may bring her into the traffic group.
